description: Public access-denied screen (template: info). Shown when a user reaches a route their role cannot see. A single info-banner explains the situation in es-EC tu voice and an action-bar routes the user back to their role landing (default employee landing SCR-my-requests; server resolves per-role destinations per SEC02) or back to sign-in. No data bindings — this screen renders no entity fields.

sections.content: Tu rol no tiene permiso para ver esta página. Si crees que deberías tener acceso, escríbele al administrador del grupo. Mientras tanto, puedes volver a tu espacio de trabajo.

role_landing.note: The 'Ir a mi espacio' action resolves the destination by the authenticated role (SEC02): employee/approver default below; unauthenticated users fall through to SCR-login. navigate_to declares the default (employee) landing.
